properties.evidence: owed.rs at v0.92.0, redo_list: for a Component it walks incoming DEPENDS_ON from components, incoming CONSTRAINS from quantities, and incoming REALIZES from an Artifact whose artifact_type maps to model or drawing (output_kind: drawing|diagram|asset → drawing, model → model). DOCUMENTS is walked only OUTWARD from a reached Artifact (a kept output), never inward to a Component. REDO_NOTE nonetheless lists "what a record documents" among the links read, without saying the direction.
